newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ now sees NZ$3.275 bln budget surplus in 1997/98.
newsitem.headline: NZ now sees NZ$3.275 bln budget surplus in 1997/98.

text.p: New Zealand Treasury on Tuesday released fresh projections showing the government would have a 1997/98 budget surplus of NZ$3.275 billion in the year to June 30, 3.2 percent of GDP.
In the previous projections in December, Treasury projected a budget surplus of $3.125 billion.
In the new projections prepared as part of the Budget Policy Statement, the surplus is projected to fall to $2.605 billion in 1998/99 and then rise to $3.457 billion in 1999/00.
